title: Chintamani Library v2.6.1 — Instant Auto-Updates, Lifecycle Resume Trigger & Student Photo Upload
releaseNotes: INSTANT AUTO-UPDATES: Background lifecycle resume listener — app checks for updates every time it is opened or resumed
FIXED: Splash screen update check race condition eliminated with synchronized sequence
NEW: Student photo upload (gallery/device storage, up to 5MB, strict branch-isolated Cloudinary storage)
REMOVED: Live selfie camera requirement completely removed from admission flow
FIXED: Eliminated low-memory errors permanently with zero-copy stream uploads
NEW: Notification tracking & deduplication — no repeated old alerts on app launch
NEW: Direct 1-Tap APK Updater download page
